description: gitIgnoredAuthors: the mise-lock-renovate.yaml workflow commits to Renovate's Go update branches. Without this, Renovate would see the branch as modified by someone else and stop rebasing and updating it.
constraints: allow minor updates for go.

Renovate's mise manager sees only mise.toml, i.e. goreleaser and yq; the Go version comes from .go-version through a regex custom manager and regex managers never touch lockfiles. So a .go-version bump leaves the "go" entries in mise.lock stale, and the next local `mise install` re-locks only the current platform, silently dropping the other seven.

The Go update PR itself is relocked by the mise-lock-renovate.yaml workflow, because lock file maintenance works only on the base branch. Lock file maintenance runs plain `mise lock`, which relocks every tool on every platform already present in the file.
Defaults are disabled and weekly, hence the explicit settings.
